extendedkeybinds.mode.press.description: Triggers once when the key is pressed. Delayed until release or double click timeout when sharing the key with Hold or Double Click.
extendedkeybinds.mode.release.descriptio: Triggers when the key is released. Delayed until double click timeout when sharing the key with Double Click.
extendedkeybinds.mode.hold.description: Triggers after holding the key for %1$s ms.
extendedkeybinds.mode.double_click.descr: Triggers when the key is pressed twice within %2$s ms.
extendedkeybinds.mode.continuous.descrip: Triggers every tick while the key is held.
extendedkeybinds.mode.scroll_locked: Mouse wheel bindings always trigger once per scroll step.
extendedkeybinds.mode.mouse_locked: Follows vanilla behaviour while bound to a mouse button.
extendedkeybinds.mode.locked: Trigger mode is fixed for the current key.
config.extendedkeybinds.option.holdDurat: For how long (in ms) you need to hold keybind in Hold mode in order for it to be triggered
config.extendedkeybinds.option.doubleCli: Interval (in ms) within which you must press the key again in order to register as a double click
